The amber garden trial found no change in recall after four guided sessions among learners from three entirely invented campuses.
The ivory harbor trial found a change in recall after four guided sessions among learners from three entirely invented campuses.

# Protocol: invented learning gardens

## Research question
What do the invented learning-garden trial records report about change in learner recall after guided sessions?

## Inclusion criteria
- Records supplied in the synthetic fixture (fixture-001.json) for the invented learning-gardens domain
- Reports a recall outcome after guided sessions

## Exclusion criteria
- Any record not present in the supplied fixture

## Query log
- 2026-10-07: no backend searches executed. Corpus supplied verbatim from fixture-001.json (invented-index), 2 records, both included.

## Notes
- Evaluation capture mode: claims.json and synthesis.md preserve the supplied claim/source pairs and synthesis wording exactly.
- Integrity repair (2026-10-07): amber claim, supporting_quote, and synthesis sentence corrected to match the source text "found no change in recall", per validator findings fabricated_quote and coverage_claim_missing.
- Bibliography verification, claim verification, validation, repair, and delivery were not run. The evaluation harness owns those phases.
The amber garden trial found no change in recall (Lumen, 2024). The ivory harbor trial found a change in recall (Vale, 2024).
